title: Patch: holding a Mythic or full-art card on a phone shows its text, not only its art
thread:
**Issue #3893 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3893: Patch: holding a Mythic or full-art card on a phone shows its text, not only its art
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What happens

On a phone, press-and-hold is how you read a card: for an ordinary card the hold opens the inspect sheet, with the card's text (B24, `cards/inspect/useInspectTrigger.tsx`). On a **Mythic**, or on any card wearing a full-art level, the same hold opens the full-screen art view instead (R3345000), so all you get is the picture. A full-art face prints no rules box (R2718000), so a phone player has no easy way to read what that card does. That's the wrong way round: these are the cards whose text you most need to read.

On desktop this isn't a problem, because hovering already shows the text (`HoverPreview` / `Extended`, which print a full-art card's text beside it). On a phone the hold is the only way in, and the full-screen view takes it over.

This is a separate polish issue from #3863 (a hold on a card with several fusions shows a black screen). That one is about the full-screen view drawing nothing. This one is about the hold opening the full-screen view at all when the player wanted the text. Don't fold them together. If #3863's PR (#3885) has merged, build on top of it.

## Where it happens

- `apps/web/src/game/Card.tsx`, around line 306: when `canFullScreen` is true, it passes `onLongPress` (and `holdAnyPointer`) to `useInspectTrigger`. B24 then calls `onLongPress` *instead of* opening the sheet (`cards/inspect/inspect.test.tsx`, "B24 with onLongPress the long-press calls it once instead of opening the sheet").
- The same pattern is in the other `onLongPress` callers: `game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.tsx`, `collection/ItemPreview.tsx`, `game/Hero.tsx`. Check each one.
- The gate is `useCanOpenFullScreen` / `canOpenFullScreen` in `apps/web/src/cards/fullscreen.ts`.

## Expected

On a touch hold, a Mythic or full-art card shows its words, just as any other card does. The full-screen art view stays reachable, but through a deliberate step. Suggested behaviour (the planner may pick a better one, but must say why):

- **Touch (phone):** a long-press on a Mythic or full-art card opens the inspect sheet, with its full text, the same as any card. The sheet already has a **Full screen** button (R3345000: "the inspect sheet's and the detail view's Full screen button"), so the art view is one tap away from there.
- **Mouse (desktop):** click-and-hold keeps opening the full-screen view as it does now. Hover already shows the text there, so nothing is lost.

This changes R3345000's "Press and hold, anywhere" bullet. Write the change down: amend the ruling's wording, or add a new ruling in this issue's block (spec/README.md, Adding a ruling). Update the B24 / R3345000 tests that expect a touch hold on a Mythic to open the full-screen view.

## Steps to reproduce

1. On a phone (or a phone-sized touch viewport), open a game, the Collection or the Almanac.
2. Press and hold a Mythic card (any Mythic shows in full art by default, #3343) or a card wearing a full-art level.
3. You see the full-screen art only. There is no card text anywhere, and no way to reach it from that view.

## Done when

- On touch, holding a Mythic or full-art card shows its full text (the inspect sheet or whatever the plan chooses) everywhere a hold works: hand, board, Collection, Almanac, deck builder, pack opening.
- The full-screen art view can still be opened from that text view on a phone.
- Desktop hover and click-and-hold behave as before, unless the plan argues otherwise.
- R3345000 (or a new ruling) states the new touch behaviour, and its proving tests (`cards/fullscreen.test.tsx`, `cards/inspect/inspect.test.tsx`, the `card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` component spec) cover a touch hold on a Mythic that opens the text, and the path from there to full screen.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.
```
